defects.title: Data for a reaction not in the model, or duplicate data, stop with an error
defects.trigger: addExoMetToEFBA(model, exoMet) with exoMet.rxns = {'EX_a'; 'EX_zz'}, EX_zz not in model.rxns (or {'EX_a'; 'EX_a'})
defects.observed: error "Unrecognized function or variable 'printLevel'." (lines 69 and 75 read printLevel instead of param.printLevel)
defects.expected: unmatched/duplicate entries ignored, penalty built from matched data

notes: Repro: model = createModel({'R1','R2','EX_a'}, {'R1','R2','EX_a'}, {'a -> b','b -> c','a <=> '}); model.lb_preconstrainRxns = model.lb; model.ub_preconstrainRxns = model.ub; exoMet = struct('rxns', {{'EX_a';'EX_zz'}}, 'mean', [2;3], 'SD', [1;1]); addExoMetToEFBA(model, exoMet) -> error "Unrecognized function or variable 'printLevel'." Same with exoMet.rxns = {'EX_a';'EX_a'}. The defect is confined to data with unmatched or duplicate reaction IDs (not recognisable in calling code). Also noted (not a separate entry): relaxBounds (default true) needs the undocumented fields lb_preconstrainRxns/ub_preconstrainRxns.
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproduction: lines 69 and 75 read an undefined printLevel when data names a missing or repeated reaction)

notes: For the lead: the table column stereochemicalSubLayers is declared logical (line 31) while getInchiData returns a count, so 3 sub-layers score 1; pinned as current behaviour (column logical, scores 15 for the 3-sub-layer InChI) and NOT recorded as a defect because the intent (count or flag) is unclear - decide whether this is a wrong-result. getInchiData is called for every non-empty InChI and editChemicalFormula only for R-group formulas (not listed as extra_edges: not every input).

notes: Repro: m = createModel({'R1'}, {'R1'}, {'a[c] -> b[c]'}); d = tempname; mkdir(d); fn = fullfile(d, 'x.csv'); writetable(table({'a';'b'}, {'C00001';'C00002'}, 'VariableNames', {'mets','KEGG'}), fn); addMetInfoInCBmodel(m, fn, true) -> 'Conversion to cell from char is not possible.'; addMetInfoInCBmodel(m, struct('mets', {{'a'}}, 'KEGG', {{'C00001'}})) -> 'Input path must be text.'. defects.title: The SMILES source is used only for metabolites that have an InChI
defects.trigger: sources {'smiles'} and a metabolite with SMILES but no InChI
defects.observed: line 358 tests inchis{idx(1)} instead of smiles{idx(1)} (found by reading; conversion not observable without a working Open Babel)

notes: Reviewer note confirmed (hmdbIDs undefined). Repro: m = createModel({'R1'}, {'R1'}, {'a[c] -> b[c]'}); d = tempname; obtainMetStructures(m, [], d, {'inchi'}) -> "Unrecognized function or variable 'hmdbIDs'."; m.metHMDBID = {'';''}; obtainMetStructures(m, [], d, {'lipidmass'}) -> VariableNames error; with {'lipidmaps'} it returns a report (structuresObtained 0). Lead decision: the help text lists metHMDBID among the model fields, so the hmdb defect could be read as an undocumented input; the lipidmass defect alone quarantines the function (confined to calls passing 'lipidmass'). The SMILES entry is from reading only (quarantine false). Also: system('obabel') returns status 1 from MATLAB here, so the code treats Open Babel as installed although it cannot run (lines 87-88 test status ~= 1). Also suspected (unobservable offline): line 387 sum(any(idMatrix')) counts at most 1 when a single source is requested; line 293 leaves molFile stale/undefined for KEGG IDs not starting with C or D. Callers: generateChemicalDatabase (line 270, default sources), getMolFilesMultipleSources (lines 90, 95).
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproductions: a model without an HMDB field fails on the undefined hmdbIDs; the documented source 'lipidmass' errors)
